Detect Magic.verbal: I call upon the elements of fire, air, earth and water, reveal to me where you may be found... Detect magic!
Detect Magic.description: This spell indicates the location and shape of all things magical to the wizard.

Shatter (Touch).verbal: By the power of the elements I shatter this...
Shatter (Touch).description: The spell will shatter one normal object (non-magical or non- spiritual) up to a volume of 27 cubic feet.
Shatter (Touch).Note: This spell, and all similar spells that affect one object of less than 27 cubic feet cannot destroy a section of a wall / floor etc - only discrete objects.

Mend (Touch).verbal: By the powers of the elements I mend this...
Mend (Touch).description: This spell mends one normal item that does not exceed 27 cubic feet in volume that has been shattered or similarly broken but not disintegrated.

Reform (Touch).verbal: By the powers of the elements I reform this...
Reform (Touch).description: This spell reforms one normal item that does not exceed 27 cubic feet in volume that has been disintegrated.

Dispel Magic 1.Note: You cannot learn Dispel 2 until you have Dispel 1, or Dispel 3 until you have Dispel 2 et cetera

Dispel Magic 2.Note: You cannot learn Dispel 2 until you have Dispel 1, or Dispel 3 until you have Dispel 2 et cetera

Dispel Magic 3.Note: You cannot learn Dispel 2 until you have Dispel 1, or Dispel 3 until you have Dispel 2 et cetera

Dispel Magic 4.Note: You cannot learn Dispel 2 until you have Dispel 1, or Dispel 3 until you have Dispel 2 et cetera

Dispel Magic 5.Note: You cannot learn Dispel 2 until you have Dispel 1, or Dispel 3 until you have Dispel 2 et cetera

Trip.verbal: By the powers of the elements trip!
Trip.description: By the casting of this spell the wizard causes one target creature to trip over an object that is in its path.
Trip.Note: The target must be moving forwards and have an object in its path to trip on, or be moving over an irregular surface.

Rope Trick.verbal: May the elements imbue this rope with power - rope trick
Rope Trick.description: When he casts this spell the wizard holds one end of a 20' rope and orders the other end to attach to any one thing.
Rope Trick.Note: If the target is animate it is able to simply shrug off the rope if it desires.  You cannot rope trick a monster or character's neck.

Detect Inanimate.verbal: I call upon the elements of fire, air, earth and water reveal to me where... may be found
Detect Inanimate.description: As Detect Magic except that any ONE type of inanimate (non fluids) object (E.g. swords, shields, etc) is detected.  It should be noted that treasure is to be found in many different configurations thus the wizard could detect gold bars or grull notes but not treasure generally.

Magic Lock.verbal: By the powers of the elements let this portal be closed... Magical Lock!
Magic Lock.description: By casting this spell the wizard causes a door, cupboard or any object that could be locked with a padlock or similar to become magically locked.  This is no way makes the locked object magical.  For example magically locked door cannot be opened but could be broken down with an axe or similar.

Talk to Inanimate.verbal: By the powers of the elements of fire, air, earth and water speak to me... and tell me what you know
Talk to Inanimate.description: This spell empowers the wizard to talk to a specific non-living and non-fluid item.  The item will answer truthfully if it is not spiritual or magical.  Spiritual items do not answer and magical items may answer as they choose, but will generally have no reason not to be truthful.  Non-supernatural items will only be aware of themselves, supernatural items may have more extensive perceptions at the referee's discretion.

Plate (Self).verbal: I call upon the power of the elements to imbue my skin with the strength of steel
Plate (Self).description: This spell confers both MAC 5 and PAC 5 all over the wizard.  This armour class does not stack with any other armour, dexterity, etc.  Including itself.

Detect Animate.verbal: I call upon the elements of fire, air, earth and water reveal to me where all that moves may be found
Detect Animate.description: As Detect Magic except that moving, living creatures (this includes fluids) are detected.

Chameleon (Self).verbal: May the elements grant me the power of Chameleon.
Chameleon (Self).description: When cast the wizard blends into the background he stands against so that he cannot be seen by normal sight.  He can however, be located by use of the Detect Magic spell etc.
Chameleon (Self).Note: The caster must be standing against something for the spell to function and the spell is broken if the wizard moves or casts another spell.  It should be noted that the wizard is still there, however, should he be observed casting the spell, he can still be attacked by a person who saw him cast the spell, as that person would know where they are...

See Through Magical Darkness (Self).verbal: I call upon the elements to grant me sight through magical darkness
See Through Magical Darkness (Self).description: This spell confers the spell caster the ability to see through magical darkness only.  It does not mean he can see through ordinary darkness thus he cannot employ an artificial light source or similar.

Enchant Item.verbal: I call into this... the elements of fire, air, earth and water
Enchant Item.description: By casting this spell the wizard enchants any normal item that does not exceed 27 cubic feet in volume so that it may be carried by an elf.  Enchanted items maintain their enchantment unless they suffer the effects of a Dispel 5 or similar - they are not disenchanted merely by being handled by non-magical beings.
Enchant Item.Note: This spell in does not give the enchanted item any magical properties (E.G.  does not make an item + O magical) though it will be revealed by detect magic.

Silence.verbal: By the power of the elements I strike thee dumb!
Silence.description: By casting this spell the wizard causes 1 target creature with not more than 4 levels resistance to become unable to utter a sound.
Silence.note: This is a stackable Glyph (see Stackable Glyphs above)
Silence.expertise: If expertly cast the 1st Rune of Silence affects at 5 levels resistance and each rune only costs 3 mana

Dispel Magic 6.verbal: By my might and the powers that be dispel 6
Dispel Magic 6.description: For further details on dispels please consult the relevant section above.

Dispel Magic 7.verbal: By my might and the powers that be dispel 7
Dispel Magic 7.description: For further details on dispels please consult the relevant section above.

Dispel Magic 8.verbal: By my might and the powers that be dispel 8
Dispel Magic 8.description: For further details on dispels please consult the relevant section above.

Dispel Magic 9.verbal: By my might and the powers that be dispel 9
Dispel Magic 9.description: For further details on dispels please consult the relevant section above.

Dispel Magic 10.verbal: By my might and the powers that be dispel 10
Dispel Magic 10.description: For further details on dispels please consult the relevant section above.

Summon Elemental 'Child'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of 'A', come forth child of 'A' I conjure thee, let a 'B' of 'A' appear!
Summon Elemental 'Child'.verbal_extra: 'A' - one of 'fire, air, earth, water, darkness, light', 'B' - Matching one of 'A' - salamander, sylph, gnome, undine, shade or sprite respectively
Summon Elemental 'Child'.description: The spell caster causes the named elemental to appear under his control.  Only one elemental, regardless of type, may be controlled at a time.  Elementals, regardless of type or size, upon contact cancel each other immediately.  A wizard cannot summon elementals of the type that directly oppose his element.  For a further description on elementals see Elementals on page 8

Extinguish.verbal: Embodiment of darkness come to me... Extinguish!
Extinguish.description: By means of this spell the caster can extinguish small non-magical light sources such as a candle, small fire, etc

Extinguish (Range).verbal: Embodiment of darkness go to there... Extinguish!

Disintegrate (Touch).verbal: By the power of darkness I disintegrate this...
Disintegrate (Touch).description: This spell will disintegrate one normal (non-magical or non-spiritual) item who's volume does not exceed 27 cubic feet.

Disintegrate (Range).verbal: By the power of darkness I disintegrate that...

Venom.verbal: Darkest venom taint this edge / drink.
Venom.description: Imbues a blade or a liquid with a BV or Ingestive poison '2' which stays until used or fades after 5 minutes.  This poison is in all ways physical poison as per the published potion, but can be dispelled (before discharge only).
Venom.Note: that its range is touch and if cast on a liquid the liquid retains its other properties after the spell fades.

Walk on Darkness (Self).verbal: Shades of dark grant me the power to walk on darkness
Walk on Darkness (Self).description: This spell allows the caster to walk on darkness as if it were solid earth.  The degree of darkness upon which walking may be attempted is total darkness to very weak candlelight.

Darkness (Self).verbal: By the power of the shades let darkness descend
Darkness (Self).description: This spell creates total magical darkness in a 10' radius of the spell caster and can be simulated by all closing their eyes when within area of effect.  The area of effect cannot be moved.  All mundane light sources within the area are negated for the duration of the spell.  The spell Light cancels the effect of this spell for the duration of the Light Spell and vice versa Darkness cancels the effect of a Light Spell.  Sprites also counteract the spell Darkness whilst present.

Walk on Darkness (Other).verbal: Shades of dark grant this person the power to walk on darkness
Walk on Darkness (Other).description: As Walk on Darkness (Self) bar range.

Animate Scarecrow.verbal: By the shades of the dark, scarecrow arise
Animate Scarecrow.description: By the use of this spell the caster creates an animate scarecrow from sticks and rags etc.  The scarecrow can take 6 hits and it delivers 6 points of damage with hands.  After taking 6 hits it is destroyed but a Mend spell will restore it to full hits again, once only, as will a Shatter destroy it.  Any fire damage inflicted on the scarecrow is permanent and cannot be mended.  Scarecrows can only accept simple commands i.e. 12 words or less.  Scarecrows cannot perform complex acts.  Scarecrows have no intelligence and have 4th Level Resistances.

Darkness (Range).verbal: By the power of the shades of the dark let darkness descend over there
Darkness (Range).description: As Darkness (Self) except it can be cast up to 20' distant from the caster.  Alternatively it can be cast centred on the spell caster (only) and thus can move with him

Black Blade.verbal: By the shades of the darkest depths I infuse this blade with darkness and harm to all
Black Blade.description: This spell increases the damage of a non-magical or spiritual edged weapon whilst held by the casting wizard by +2 grades but this is still physical damage.  If the black bladed weapon is used by anyone else it only does +1 grade of extra damage.  The venom is a magically created poison and not countered by blade venom antidotes.  The weapon cannot be further enhanced e.g. by poison, Fireblade etc
Black Blade.Note: Unlike normal poisons it is not necessary for a black bladed weapon to cut the target for the magical poison to take effect.  All the damage from such a weapon is LOC and TBLP, and added directly to the base damage of the weapon.  Immunity to poison does stop all the extra damage from this spell.  Despite having magically generated poison a black bladed weapon does not inflict magical damage.

Catalepsy.verbal: By the shades of dark, I command that you shall die… Catalepsy!
Catalepsy.description: This spell causes one target creature that has no more than 4 levels to fall into a cataleptic state.
Catalepsy.Note: This is a stackable Glyph (see Stackable Glyphs above)
Catalepsy.expertise: If expertly cast the 1st Rune of Catalepsy affects at 5 levels resistance and each rune only costs 4 mana

Talk to Shade.verbal: Mighty shade speak to me and relate what thou knowest
Talk to Shade.description: The shades will have knowledge of what has happened in any darkness or shadows within a 10' radius.  Shades have excellent memories.  This can also be used to converse with any actual elemental shades present.

Summon Shade 'Child'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of darkness, Come forth child of darkness, I conjure thee, let a shade of darkness appear
Summon Shade 'Child'.description: Summons a Shade with 10 hits which inflicts 6pts Single by Unarmed Combat

Dancing Venom Sword.verbal: Shades of the dark I conjure thee, imbue this blade with power and the darkest venom and let it dance to my tune
Dancing Venom Sword.description: This spell creates an ordinary bastard sword coated with magical venom to dance as directed by the spell caster.  The spell is ended if the caster loses sight of the sword even for a second, takes damage, or goes out of range.  The damage done by the sword is 9 points Bastard Double (normal) + 15 points of poison damage (for a total of 24pt Venom Quad).  Any creature immune to normal weapons will be unaffected by this spell.  Creatures that are immune to poison will take only the 9 points of normal damage.  The sword cannot be further enhanced by any means e.g.  poison, Blackblade, Fireblade.
Dancing Venom Sword.Note: Unlike normal poisons it is not necessary for a DVS to cut the target for the magical poison to take effect.  All the damage from such a weapon is LOC and TBLP and added to the base damage of the weapon.  Despite having magically generated poison a DVS does not inflict magical damage. Magic only to hit creatures cannot be affected by either Blackblade or Dancing Venom Sword.

Summon Shade 'Prince'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of darkness, come forth prince of darkness I conjure thee let a shade of darkness appear
Summon Shade 'Prince'.description: Summons a Shade with 15 hits which inflicts 9pt Double by Unarmed Combat

Summon Shade 'Lord'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of darkness, I abjure the elements of light, fire, air, earth and water and I conjure thee, come forth Lord of darkness I summon thee, let a shade of darkness appear
Summon Shade 'Lord'.description: Summons a Shade with 25 hits which inflicts 12pt Double by Unarmed Combat

Puff of Air.verbal: Embodiment of air come to me!
Puff of Air.description: By casting this spell the wizard can create a puff of fresh air sufficient to blow out a candle or knock over a small goblet, within 20 feet of the caster

Jump (Self).verbal: Sylphs of air take me there
Jump (Self).description: This spell allows the spell caster to jump 20' forwards or 10' backwards or 15' upwards.  It nominally takes two seconds to complete the jump, and Time Stop should generally be called.  “Jumping” will generally allow those involved (bar the Jumper) to perform one simple action such as a single blow or other 'instant' abilities which need no verbal can be used (just one ability - not a string of Neuronic Penetrations!) instead of a weapon swing, including speaking a single word. Complex actions will be disallowed by the ref!

Mend (Range).verbal: By the powers of air I mend that...
Mend (Range).description: This spell will mend any (non-magical/spiritual) object that has been shattered or similarly broken, but not rusted, warped or disintegrated.  The object's volume must not exceed 27 cubic feet.  This spell can be used to mend things that have been broken by mundane means, e.g. a broken door.  The complexity of what can be mended is at the referee's discretion.

Shatter (Range).verbal: By the powers of air I shatter that...

Jump (Other).verbal: Sylphs of air I bid thee take this person there
Jump (Other).description: See Jump (Self).  The recipient of this spell must be willing

Storm Blast.verbal: By the powers of air and thunder, storm blast
Storm Blast.description: This spell inflicts 12 total body life points (TBLP) of damage and two to each location (loc) on one character or 4 hits to a monster
Storm Blast.expertise: After first casting within a one-minute period Stormblast may now be cast at one mana point less.  So that a Stormblast costs 3 mana but 5 Stormblasts unleashed in succession would cost 3+2+2+2+2= 11 mana rather than 15 mana.  Once 3000 points past 8th is reached Stormblast becomes a 2-mana glyph to cast in all ways.

Telekinesis.Duration: 5 Minutes or until movement completed, whichever shorter
Telekinesis.verbal: Sylphs of air I conjure thee telekinesise that... to there
Telekinesis.description: This spell will move one object as directed by the caster.  The force of the telekinesis is equal to the force the referee can exert with one hand nor can it be used to wield a weapon effectively.  It cannot pick up objects that contain a spirit.  Only one Telekinesis may be cast upon one object or by a wizard at any one time.

Walk on Air (Self).verbal: Sylphs of air grant me the power to walk on air
Walk on Air (Self).description: This spell allows the caster to Walk on Air.  The amount of height gained (or lost) is equal to one foot of vertical height per step taken.  The caster is walking and must remain upright and hence his lower half may be vulnerable when the ceiling is low.

Walk on Air (Other).verbal: Sylphs of the air grant this person the power to walk on air

Blink.verbal: By the powers of the sylphs of air let me be taken there… Blink
Blink.description: This spell allows the spell caster to teleport up to 20' in distance or within sight! On arriving at the destination the caster appears in the same orientation and pose as when he phased out and it takes the spell caster 2 seconds to re-materialise, during which time he is not vulnerable to external damage and any ongoing effects are delayed by 2 seconds.

Lightning Bolt.verbal: By the powers of air and rolling thunder…  Lightning bolt!
Lightning Bolt.description: This spell inflicts 24 points of damage on one character's total body life points (TBLP) and 4 points of damage to each of his locations (LOC).  This spell damage ignores any non-magical armour.  Alternatively it delivers 8 hits of damage to a monster.
Lightning Bolt.expertise: After first casting within a one-minute period Lightning Bolt may now be cast at one mana point less.  So that a Lightning Bolt costs 6 mana but 5 Lightning Bolts unleashed in succession would cost 6+5+5+5+5 = 26 mana rather than 30 mana.  Once 3000 points past 8th is reached Lightning Bolt becomes a 5-mana glyph to cast.

Sleep.verbal: By the power of the imps of slumber: 'Sleep!',
Sleep.verbal_extra: and then indicate how many levels of effect its cast at
Sleep.description: This spell causes one target creature, that has no more than 4 levels, to fall magically asleep for 5 minutes.  During this period it is not possible to awaken the victim by any mundane non-magical means, such as shaking or striking, et cetera.
Sleep.Note: This is a stackable Glyph (see Stackable Glyphs on page 8)
Sleep.expertise: If expertly cast the 1st Rune of Sleep affects at 5 levels resistance and each rune only costs 5 mana

Talk to Sylph.verbal: Mighty sylph speak to me and relate what thou knowest
Talk to Sylph.description: The Sylph will have knowledge of what has transpired in the air of the area (10' radius) of the caster and it will have knowledge of such things as conversation etc.  A Sylph's memory is not reliable when recalling things of a week of more in the past.  Otherwise see Talk to Shade.

Summon Sylph 'Child'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of air, come forth child of air I conjure thee, let a sylph of air appear
Summon Sylph 'Child'.description: Summons a Sylph with 10 hits which inflicts 6pt Single by Unarmed Combat

Summon Sylph 'Prince'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of air, come forth prince of air I conjure thee, let a sylph of air appear.
Summon Sylph 'Prince'.description: Summons a Sylph with 15 hits which inflicts 9pt Double by Unarmed Combat

Dancing Sword.verbal: Sylphs of air I conjure thee, imbue this sword with power and let it dance
Dancing Sword.description: This spell will imbue a normal sword with power in effect making it a +2 magic weapon for the duration of the spell.  It will 'dance' and strike at anything the spell caster directs it to, for 5 minutes.  The spell caster must concentrate fully on, and be able to see the sword at all times, and remain within range also.  Also he must direct every blow of the dancing sword.  If concentration is broken, by say the wizard being hurt, casting another spell etc the spell is ruined.  If this happens the sword loses the magical enhancement it received from the spell.  The sword will inflict 18 life points of damage to a character's TBLP and loc or three magic hits on monsters.
Dancing Sword.Note: The sword cannot be enhanced in any further way E.g.  by poison, Blackblade, Fireblade etc.

Summon Sylph 'Lord'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of air, I abjure the elements of fire, earth, water, darkness and light and I conjure thee, come forth lord of air I summon thee let a sylph of air appear.
Summon Sylph 'Lord'.description: Summons a Sylph with 25 hits, which inflicts 12pt Double by Unarmed Combat.

Pebble (Cantrip).verbal: Embodiment of earth come to me
Pebble (Cantrip).description: By the casting of this spell the wizard causes a small pebble to appear in his hand.

Warp (Touch).verbal: By the powers of earth I warp this...
Warp (Touch).description: By casting this spell the wizard can warp one normal item with a volume of 27 cubic feet.  Warped items are basically shapeless and useless.  Warping a helmet will not cause it to damage the wearer.  A warped object cannot be Mended although it can be Reshaped.

Stoneskin (Self).verbal: I call upon the gnomes of earth to imbue my skin with the strength of stone
Stoneskin (Self).description: Confers PAC 6 on the spell caster, non-stacking with all other AC.

Reshape (Touch).verbal: By the powers of earth reshape this... into a...
Reshape (Touch).description: This spell enables the wizard to reshape any normal item that does not exceed 27 cubic feet in volume into another item of roughly the same size and material.  It is not possible to reshape metal into swords or armour etc, even if the caster has weapon or armour making abilities, as the product is not well-made, balanced, weighted or similar.  Similarly uncut gems cannot be made into polished valuable items, or lumps of gold into valuable goblets etc.  However reshape can reverse the effect of a 'Warp'.
Reshape (Touch).Note: A piece of armour has numerous components and any new items will have very limited durability.

Warp (Range).verbal: By the powers of earth I warp that...

Stoneskin (Other).verbal: I call upon the gnomes of earth to imbue this person's skin with the strength of stone

Bind.verbal: By the power of earth I bind thee.
Bind.description: Binds any non-supernatural inanimate object or any form of footwear that is currently in touch with an earthern surface to the ground for five minutes.  This can include walls in caves or buildings, if the target is in contact with a wall but not the floor.  Any Bind style effect may be broken out of with 30seconds active work with a sharp weapon.

Magnetise.verbal: By the powers of earth I magnetise that...
Magnetise.description: By the casting of this spell the wizard causes 1 metal object to be irresistibly attracted to the nearest wall or the ground.  If a players' armour is magnetised, the spell does not take effect until the character wearing the metal armour moves, i.e. that item must be in motion for the effect to be realised.  This spell does not work on objects containing a spirit.

Entangle.verbal: By the powers of earth I entangle you.
Entangle.description: Causes the natural vegetation to spring up and entangle all creatures within a 3' radius area as directed by the wizard.  There must be sufficient natural vegetation for this spell to work.  The size of the vegetation is proportional to size of the creature that can be captured and the extent of the restraint.  For example, trees could entangle a dragon at least temporarily!  In general it should be assumed that 'normal' creatures cannot tear free of any constraint more extensive than grass, but also that except in the cases of the densest vegetation only the target's legs are tangled, and they are still free to move their arms and speak etc.  Extended work with a sharp weapon to cut free may be acceptable at the ref's discretion.

Reshape (Range).verbal: By the powers of earth I reshape that... into a...

Magic Missile.verbal: I call upon the gnomes of earth, imbue this rock with power - magic missile!
Magic Missile.description: This spell charges one rock (a safe phys-rep must be used) with power.  Thrown it does 12 points of damage to the first player's location it hits he also loses 12 points from his total life points alternatively it does 4 hits to monsters.  It disregards all forms of armour bar actual MAC, e.g. a suit of +0 Magic Armour would not offer any protection against a Magic Missile.  The first object struck causes the rock to be discharged so no rebounds.
Magic Missile.Note: Players must provide their own safe phys-rep.
Magic Missile.expertise: May now inflict a 6/1 blast regardless of MAC.  This spell now inflicts 6 hits to monsters rather than 4

Walk on Earth (Self).verbal: Gnomes of earth grant me the power to walk on earth
Walk on Earth (Self).description: Allows the spell caster to walk on any stone or earthen surface whether it is a cave wall or a stone roof or marshy ground etc.  While so benefiting the caster is also rendered immune to ground-shaking 'knockdown' type effects like Earth Tremor.

Passwall.verbal: Gnomes of earth I conjure thee, grant me the power to passwall
Passwall.description: This spell allows the caster to walk through any wall or stone object of not more than 10' in thickness.  If the wall is more than 10' thick the spell fails to work but mana and life points are still expended.  It does not apply to floors and the user can only walk in a straight line.  You cannot cast multiple Passwall spells to allow more movement.

Walk on Earth (Other).verbal: Gnomes of earth grant this person the power to walk on earth

Chameleon (Other).verbal: May the gnomes of earth grant this person the powers of chameleon
Chameleon (Other).description: See Grey Spell Chameleon (Self), except subject can only be hidden when surroundings are of stone, earth etc. This glyph may be cast as if 3mp when used on self.

Wall of Stone.verbal: Gnomes of earth I conjure thee, build for me a wall of stone
Wall of Stone.description: This spell causes a stone wall of maximum dimensions 10' high by 20 ' wide and 1' thick to spring up from the ground.  The wall cannot be toppled by force or shattered by a spell, but a dispel 4 or greater will cause it to vanish.  A Wall of Stone is supernaturally supported and does not require any anchor points for it to remain upright.

Plate (Other).verbal: I call upon the gnomes of earth to imbue this person's skin with the strength of steel.

Supermissile.verbal: I call upon the mighty gnomes of earth imbue this rock with great power - supermissile!
Supermissile.description: As Magic Missile (3 MP) on above, but it does 12 points of damage to players via the location it hits and TBLP, to which only MAC applies, and a 12tblp 2pts blast effect.  This blast effect ignore all armour including MAC as the missile detonates from within the target.  It does 8  hits to monsters.

Talk to Gnome.verbal: Mighty gnome speak to me and relate what thou knowest
Talk to Gnome.description: A gnome will know what has happened on or around earth or stone.  Gnomes have excellent memories.  Otherwise see Talk to Shade.

Summon Gnome 'Child'.verbal: By the power my command I summon the element of earth, come forth child of earth I conjure thee let a gnome of earth appear
Summon Gnome 'Child'.description: Summons a Gnome with 10 hits, which inflicts 6pt Single by Unarmed Combat.

Summon Gnome 'Prince'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of earth, come forth prince of earth, I conjure thee let a gnome of earth appear
Summon Gnome 'Prince'.description: Summons a Gnome with 15 hits, which inflicts 9pt Double by Unarmed Combat.

Summon Gnome 'Lord'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of earth.  I abjure the elements of water, darkness, light, fire and air and I conjure thee.  Come forth lord of earth I summon thee let a gnome of earth appear
Summon Gnome 'Lord'.description: Summons a Gnome with 25 hits, which inflicts 12pt double by Unarmed Combat.

Create Water.verbal: Embodiment of water come to me
Create Water.description: By casting this spell the wizard creates half a pint of pure water within 10' of himself.
Create Water.Note: Water cannot be created inside an animate object or person.

Unlock (Touch).verbal: By my power let this lock be opened
Unlock (Touch).description: This spell allows the caster to unlock one normal lock without the use of a key and will also unlock an object that has had Magic Lock cast upon it.

Rust (Touch).verbal: By the powers of water I rust this...
Rust (Touch).description: By the use of this spell the caster rusts one normal ferrous object of a volume not more than 27 cubic feet.  It is totally rusted away to nothing and thus cannot be restored by a Mend, Reform or Reshape spell.

Unlock (Range).verbal: By my power let that lock be opened

Rust (Range).verbal: By the powers of water I rust that…

Passive Illusion.verbal: Undine at my command create a phantasm of...  to do my will
Passive Illusion.description: By casting this spell the wizard creates a visual illusion of any object or creature he desires.  The illusion can move and the wizard can see through its eyes.  A wizard can play a passive illusion of himself.  The illusion does not smell and cannot make any sound.  Furthermore should it be struck or have a spell cast at it, it vanishes.  Once spell is cast the illusion may leave the range.  A Passive Illusion can be no smaller than 1' across, and no larger than an object with a 10' radius, and can only be a single creature/object, not a 'scene'.  If smaller than a small humanoid it is unstable, and should it move faster than a steady walk it will dissipate.

Walk on or through Water (Self).verbal: Undines of water grant me the power to walk on / through water
Walk on or through Water (Self).description: This spell has two applications.  It can be used to allow the wizard to walk on water as if it was normal ground or it can be used to allow him to breathe normally under water.  Either version of this Spell grants the caster 50% off Acid, Water based attacks, poisons and potions.  This includes beneficial potions.
Walk on or through Water (Self).Note: To gain both effects the wizard would have to cast the spell twice.

Illusions of Grandeur.verbal: Undines grant him/her phantasms of power and valour to aid him.
Illusions of Grandeur.description: This spell grants the beneficiary immunity to non-spiritual Fear and Emotion Attacks, and +6/2 temporary life (non-stacking with other temporary life increases), unless they are immune to insanity (or to illusions for any reason).  It may not be cast on any person capable of casting the glyph themselves, as the deeper understanding of the glyph precludes the needed subconscious belief.  It cannot otherwise be 'disbelieved'.

Level:.verbal: Undine at my command create a phantasm of... to do my will and let it appear in (time 1 sec to 5 mins)
Level:.description: As Passive Illusion (3MP) except that the illusion can be programmed to appear from 1 sec.  to 5 mins after the verbal is completed, and follow a set of instructions rather than be directed by the caster at the time.

Summon Undine.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of water, let an undine of water appear
Summon Undine.description: Summons an Undine with 6 hits that inflicts 4pt Single by Unarmed Combat, and is dissipated by contact with any other elemental.

Unseen Servant.verbal: By my power I summon a phantasm to fetch and carry as I direct
Unseen Servant.description: As Blue spell Telekinesis except that once instructed the unseen servant will not require the continued concentration of the wizard unless he wishes to give it further instructions.  The servant cannot pick up an item with a spiritual component. An unseen servant cannot fight, but is destroyed by 4 hits of damage.

Walk on or through Water (Other).verbal: Undines of water grant this person the power to walk on or through water
Walk on or through Water (Other).description: See Walk on or through Water (Self).

Slow.verbal: With the power of the undines of water... Slow!
Slow.description: By casting this spell the wizard causes one target creature of not more than 4 levels to be slowed to a slow zombie speed (i.e. as if they were walking through water not air).
Slow.Note: This is a stackable Glyph (see Stackable Glyphs on page 8)
Slow.expertise: If expertly cast the 1st Rune of Slow affects at 5 levels resistance and each rune only costs 4 mana

Talk to Undine.verbal: Mighty undine speak to me and relate what thou knowest
Talk to Undine.description: An Undine will know what has happened in or around liquids.  Otherwise see Talk to Shade.

Summon Undine 'Child'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of water, come forth child of water, let an undine of water appear
Summon Undine 'Child'.description: Summons an Undine with 10 hits that inflicts 6pt Single by Unarmed Combat.

Semi-Active Illusion.verbal: Undines at my command create a phantasm of... to do my will and embody it with thy power
Semi-Active Illusion.description: As Passive Illusion except that the semi-active illusion is capable of doing 6 points of damage per blow it strikes.  It can be dispelled in the normal manner or disbelieved.  The illusion will waver and fade after taking 15 hits.  If disbelieved the damage does not vanish.  It otherwise follows the same strictures as Passive Illusion, but must be at least the size of a small humanoid or it is incapable of inflicting damage at all.
Semi-Active Illusion.Note: The wizard may NOT play his own semi-active illusion.

Vanish.verbal: By all my power I command that... to vanish!
Vanish.description: By casting this spell the wizard causes one non-living item that does not possess a spirit or exceed 27 cubic feet in volume to vanish for 5 minutes.  After the expiry of the spell the item will re-appear in the same spot it disappeared from or if the item was worn it would reappear in the same position relative to the wearer.  The item whilst vanished does not exist at any other location. E.g. A small trap door would re-appear closed (locked) if it was originally closed and locked. E.g. A magic ring vanished from a finger would re-appear on that finger even if the person wearing the ring has moved several miles, light years - planes etc.
Vanish.expertise: With Expertise, Vanish may be cast a second time within a minute of a first casting for only 4 mana. This may not be extended to a third or further castings.

Summon Undine 'Prince'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of water, come forth prince of water, let an undine of water appear
Summon Undine 'Prince'.description: Summons an Undine with 15 hits, which inflicts 9pt Double by Unarmed Combat.

Summon Undine 'Lord'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of water.  I abjure the elements of darkness, light, fire, air and earth, and I conjure thee, come forth lord of water I summon thee let an undine of water appear
Summon Undine 'Lord'.description: Summons an Undine with 25 hits, which inflicts 12pt Double by Unarmed Combat.

Ignite (Touch).verbal: By the powers of fire ignite this...
Ignite (Touch).description: This spell when cast has the same effect as putting a small flame (e.g. a match) to an item for 2 to 3 seconds.

Ignite (Range).verbal: By the powers of fire ignite that...
Ignite (Range).description: As ignite (Touch) but with increased range.

Shock.verbal: Into my hand I call forth fire... Shock!
Shock.description: By casting this spell the wizard causes his touch to do 12 points of damage to the location and total body points of players.  Alternatively it does 4 hits to monsters.  The only AC that may be applies versus this damage is MAC, which applies on a 1 for 1 basis (so MAC2 reduces the damage by 2tblp and 2 to the location touched). Once the verbal is completed the wizard has 5 seconds to discharge the spell or it is wasted.  He cannot cast any more spells in this time.  This spell only causes damage to the first target struck so don't pick your nose!

Fire Blast.verbal: By the powers of fire and brimstone... Fire Blast!
Fire Blast.description: When he casts this spell the wizard causes one player to take 12 points of total body damage and 2 points per location.  Alternatively a monster take 4 hits.  This is magical damage against which MAC may be applied versus this damage.
Fire Blast.expertise: After first casting within a one-minute period Fire Blast may now be cast at one mana point less.  So that a Fire Blast costs 3 mana but 5 Fire Blasts unleashed in succession would cost 3+2+2+2+2 = 11 mana rather than 15 mana.  Once Table 10 is reached Fire Blast becomes a 2 mana glyph to cast at all times.

Walk Through Fire (Self).verbal: Salamanders of fire grant me the power to walk through fire.
Walk Through Fire (Self).description: This spell confers upon the caster total immunity to normal fires and a 50% reduction off all damage taken from magical fires.

Melt.verbal: By the powers of fire I melt that...
Melt.description: This spell affects one, non-spiritual, metal object that does not exceed 27 cubic feet in volume, to become heated such that it melts.  This spell can affect a single location's worth of metal armour.  If used on metal armour or on a metal object that is being held then the wielder takes 6/6 damage to that location exactly as per Shock.  A melted object cannot be repaired by a Mend, Reform or Reshape spell.

Fireblade.verbal: I call upon the power of the salamanders to imbue this blade with fire
Fireblade.description: When cast on a bladed weapon it adds +1 hit of magical fire damage to that weapon's normal damage when wielded by the casting wizard.  If the firebladed weapon is used by anyone else the weapon's damage is not enhanced but it does magical fire damage.

Walk Through Fire (Other).verbal: Salamanders of fire, grant this person the power to walk through fire.
Walk Through Fire (Other).description: As Walk through Fire (self) above, bar range.

Wall of Fire.verbal: Salamander of fire I conjure thee, build for me a wall of fire
Wall of Fire.description: By casting this spell the wizard creates an opaque wall of fire that stretches from wall to wall and floor to roof, to a maximum of 40' in any direction.  Any player breaking through the wall of fire will take 12 points damage to total body life points and 2 to each location, a monster takes 4 hits.  Only MAC may be applied versus this damage.  It is not possible to see through a wall of fire.  A Wall of Fire cannot be cast within 2 paces of another wall of fire.  If they are created too close both are negated.  Any creature remaining within a Wall of Fire for over 10seconds takes an Ignite [t] to all equipment carried.

Fire Bolt.verbal: By the powers of fire and scorching brimstone...  Fire bolt!
Fire Bolt.description: This spell inflicts 24 points of damage on one character's total body life points (TBLC) and 4 points of damage to each of his locations (LOC).  This spell damage ignores any non-magical armour.  Alternatively it delivers 8 hits of damage to a monster.  MAC applies against this magical fire damage at a rate of MAC 1 stops 6/1 damage.
Fire Bolt.expertise: Firebolt is considered a 5 mp glyph.

Summon Salamander 'Child'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of fire, come forth child of fire I conjure thee, let a salamander of fire appear
Summon Salamander 'Child'.description: Summons a Salamander with 10 hits, which inflicts 6pt Single by Unarmed Combat.

Sword of Power.verbal: Into my hands I call forth fire, blade, hilt and guard.  Sword of power I conjure thee to scorch my enemies
Sword of Power.description: This spell creates a bastard sword of 'solid' flame, useable only by the spell caster and grants the caster B Skill with it.  It does 12 points of pure magical damage (Double) if wielded in one hand or 15 points of pure magic damage (Bastard Triple) if wielded in two hands.  Whilst the spell is active the caster may not wield any other weapon.

Talk to Salamander.verbal: Mighty Salamander speak to me and tell me what thou knowest
Talk to Salamander.description: The Salamander will know what has happened within a 20' radius of its flame whilst the flame has been alight.

Disruption.verbal: By all the powers of fire be thou scorched, be charred, be burnt, disruption!
Disruption.description: This spell causes 36 total body and 6 per location of magical fire damage to one character or 12 hits to a monster.  Only MAC may be applied versus this damage.
Disruption.expertise: Disruption may be cast for 7 mana.  Once table 10 is reached, each casting after the first in a one-minute period is only 6 mp.

Summon Salamander 'Prince'.verbal: By power at my command I summon thee element of fire, come forth prince of fire let a salamander of fire appear
Summon Salamander 'Prince'.description: Summons a Salamander with 15 hits, which inflicts 9pt Double by Unarmed Combat.

Summon Salamander 'Lord'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of fire, I abjure the elements of air, earth, water, darkness and light and I conjure thee, come forth Lord of fire I summon thee, let a salamander of fire appear
Summon Salamander 'Lord'.description: Summons a Salamander with 25 hits, which inflicts 12pt Double by Unarmed Combat.

Flash.verbal: Embodiment of light come to me... Flash!
Flash.description: By casting this spell the wizard creates a bright flash of light (equivalent to a light spell) and counteracts Darkness for its 5-second duration.

Farsee.verbal: Sprites bend thy light so that I may see (place)
Farsee.description: This spell when cast allows the wizard to take a 2 second glance at any place up to 40' distant.  (E.G.  behind a closed door, round a corner etc.  ).  It does not provide a light source for that glance

Snowflake (Self).Duration: The time it takes to fall
Snowflake (Self).description: This spell when cast allows the wizard to fall any distance and take no damage.
Snowflake (Self).Note: The spell must be cast before the wizard hits the ground.

Light (Self).verbal: Sprites of light I conjure thee shine forth on all before me
Light (Self).description: This spell creates sufficient light to illuminate a 20' diameter area.  The lit area cannot be moved.  The spell Darkness cancels the effect of this spell for the duration of the Darkness Spell and vice versa - a 'Light cancels the effect of a 'Darkness' spell.

Snowball.verbal: By the might of ice... snowball!
Snowball.description: As Magic Missile except that this spell does double damage versus fire based creatures and does not need a pebble to be cast on.  It does not gain Expertise benefits as Magic Missile however.

Walk on Light (Self).verbal: Sprites of light grant me the power to walk on light
Walk on Light (Self).description: This spell allows the wizard to walk on rays of light (equal to a strong 'candlelight' or greater intensity).  Should the light disappear the wizard will fall to the ground.

Snowflake (Other).Duration: The time it takes to fall
Snowflake (Other).description: This spell when cast allows the target to fall any distance and take no damage.
Snowflake (Other).Note: The spell must be cast before the target hits the ground.

Light (Range).verbal: Sprites of light I conjure thee shine forth over there / around me
Light (Range).description: As Light (self) except that the light centres on a point up to 20' distant from the wizard, alternatively it can be cast on the wizard and move with him.

Wall of Ice.verbal: With the mighty powers of cold I create a wall of ice
Wall of Ice.description: This spell creates an opaque wall of ice 1 foot thick that stretches from wall to wall and floor to roof, to a maximum of 40' in any direction.  The wall will take 400 hits (100 fire based hits) before collapsing.

See Through Magical Darkness (Other).verbal: Sprites of light grant this person sight through magical darkness
See Through Magical Darkness (Other).description: This spell confers one willing recipient with the power to see through magical darkness only; it does not mean he can see through ordinary darkness!

Walk on Light (Other).verbal: Sprites of light grant this person the power to walk on light

Freeze.verbal: With the might of ice I freeze thee still!
Freeze.description: This spell freezes one target creature, so that they are frozen in place and cannot move for the duration of the spell.
Freeze.Note: This is a stackable Glyph (see Stackable Glyphs on page 8)
Freeze.expertise: If expertly cast the 1st Rune of Freeze affects at 5 levels resistance and each rune only costs 5 mana

Plasma Bolt.verbal: By the powers of the brightest light I smite thee... Plasma Bolt!
Plasma Bolt.description: By casting this spell the wizard creates a beam of light of great intensity that inflicts 24 magical points total body damage and 4 per location to one player, it does 8 hits to a monster.  Only MAC may be applied versus the damage from this spell
Plasma Bolt.expertise: After the first casting within a one-minute period Plasma Bolt may now be cast at one mana point less.  So that a Plasma Bolt costs 6 mana but 5 Plasma Bolts unleashed in succession would cost 6+5+5+5+5 = 26 mana rather than 30 mana.  Once Tb 10 is reached Plasma Bolt becomes a 5-mana glyph to cast.

Summon Sprite 'Child'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of light, Come forth child of light I conjour thee, let a sprite of light appear
Summon Sprite 'Child'.description: Summons a Sprite with 10 hits which inflicts 6pt Single by Unarmed Combat
Summon Sprite 'Child'.Note: A sprite counteracts magical darkness whilst it is present.

Talk to Sprite.verbal: Mighty sprite speak to me and relate what thou knowest
Talk to Sprite.description: The sprite knows what has happened in a 15' radius and only whilst the area was lit.  If outdoors the sprite will only know what has happened in the daytime.

Sabre of Light and Truth.verbal: Into my hands I call forth the purest light a blade, a hilt and a guard, sabre of light and truth I conjure thee to smite the darkness
Sabre of Light and Truth.description: This spell creates a bastard sword of pure light, useable only by the spell caster and grants the caster B Skill with it.  It does 12 points of pure magical damage if wielded in one hand or 15 points of pure magic damage if wielded in two hands.  Whilst the spell is active the caster may not wield any other weapon.  Additionally versus any evil or darkness based creature it inflicts a 6/1 Blast as well to which MAC does not apply (2 Hits).  The extra damage will not exceed the user's maximum damage, however so even though when used in 2 hands versus evil it would inflict Triple +2 hits in a blast, the user may only call Quad without additional abilities to increase their max damage.  The wielder can also see through magical darkness.
Sabre of Light and Truth.Note: This spell is useable only by characters of good alignment

Summon Sprite 'Prince'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of light, Come forth prince of light let a sprite of light appear
Summon Sprite 'Prince'.description: Summons a Sprite with 15 hits which inflicts 9pt Double by Unarmed Combat

Summon Sprite 'Lord'.verbal: By the power at my command I summon the element of light, I abjure the elements of darkness, fire, air, earth, and water and I conjure thee, come forth Lord of light I summon thee, let a sprite of light appear
Summon Sprite 'Lord'.description: Summons a Sprite with 25 hits, which inflicts 12pt Double by Unarmed Combat.

tell strength.verbal: by the drake reveal thine strength''
tell strength.description: this reveals to the wizard the resistance level of the target with respect to bronze magic.  the response that the wizard receives is the number of stackable runes that would need to be cast on the target in order for a stackable spell to work.  see silver 'tell strength' for further details.

limb thrall.verbal: fool, feel the might of true power.....limb thrall
limb thrall.description: this is a level-based stackable spell, with resistances applying as listed under the tell strength spell listed above.  all other effects of the spell are as the spell thrall below but it applies to only one limb at a time.  the casting wizard may have more than one limb thrall active at a time.
limb thrall.note: this is a stackable glyph (see stackable glyphs on page 8)

shudder.verbal: fool, feel your mortal form twist and shudder under my power''
shudder.description: the target of the spell suffers a drop in dexterity armour class of 3 points, caused by uncontrollable shakes.  this can negate physical armour class, but will not drop the total armour class below 0.  if this is cast on a monster then it decreases the monsters hits by 6.  the minimum number of hits that a monster can be left with is 1, as clearly this spell cannot kill, but merely increase the amount of damage that the victim receives during combat. this spell does not stack with itself. immunity to dexterity drain or domination effects applies.

thrall.verbal: by the might of the bronze drake i am now your master and ye shall follow my commands.....thrall 4 levels'
thrall.description: this is a stackable spell, similar to sleep, but the target comes under the control of the casting wizard, becoming an unwilling automaton. the thrall will do nothing unless ordered to do so by the wizard, which includes defending themselves.  the target retains life/hit points and resistances as usual, but loses all weapon masteries, dexterity armour class and any skill that requires knowledge, which includes spell casting, or using mystical innates.  only psionics and other powers that may be triggered without any exterior motion or verbals can be used at the will of the victim.  the victim can be ordered to commit suicide, but it must beat itself to death using its own strength.  a thrall victim automatically develops the unarmed combat ability and may use any strength abilities that it may have.  also, they are not penalised for actions committed whilst under the influence of the spell - i.e. a priest drawing blood has no side effects. should the casting wizard of the thrall die; the spell is broken - as it is should the caster lose consciousness.
thrall.note: this is a stackable glyph (see stackable glyphs on page 8)
thrall.expertise: may cast thrall for 5mana per rune, with the 1st rune affecting 5 levels.

words of pain.verbal: hear now my words of pain.....''
words of pain.description: the target stands or falls writhing in agony, unable to make any other action unless struck by another blow or spell.  during this period the target takes 6 tblp damage and 1 point to each location (2 hits to a monster) per 15 seconds, as long as the casting wizard stands talking to the target, up to a maximum of 5 minutes.  the damage ignores any form of armour class.  should the wizard elect to move around, stop talking or if the wizard takes damage or if the target takes any other damage then the spell is cancelled.  this spell does not effect creatures which do not feel pain, such as elementals, undead and the like.  this is not a listed stopping effect, and only complete immunity to pain effects can prevent the writhing detailed above.
words of pain.expertise: may now cast this spell for 12 mana.

words of death.verbal: hear now my words of death.....''
words of death.description: as long as the wizard does not move from where they stand and they keep talking to the target then the target will suffer the effects of a magical disorder, which progresses at the following rate:	up to 1 minute:	they become too weak to move or cast, and collapse after 1 minute:	they are unconscious after 2 minutes:	they die this spell is broken if the wizard takes damage, casts another spell or moves from where he is standing, and then the mana is wasted.  the spell is not broken should the target be struck, however.  as this produces effects like a disease any creatures who are immune to disease are not affected by this spell.
words of death.expertise: expertise: may now cast this spell for 14 mana.

pain.verbal: by the ebony drake i smite thee with pain
pain.description: the target of the spell is struck with a nerve wracking pain which causes a character 12 tblp damage (4 hits to a monster) - magical armour class does protect against this damage (at 1 for 1), and the damage is magical. only creatures vulnerable to pain are affected of course - undead and elementals, for example, are unharmed.

confusion.verbal: be thou filled with doubt and confusion'
confusion.description: this stackable spell causes a target affected to become unsure of what they are doing, they regard all around them as potential enemies, but will only initiate violence against those who attack them.  they will otherwise take no other action other than to defend themselves. this is a domination effect, not a stopping effect.
confusion.note: this is a stackable glyph (see stackable glyphs on page 8)
confusion.expertise: may now cast this spell for 3 mana per rune, and starting at 5 levels of effect.

spell shield.verbal: shield my body from magic, great ebony drake
spell shield.description: this spell prevents any information spell working on the ebony wizard for the duration of the spell shield spell. this includes detect magic, but recognise mana will still give the normal responses.

induce spasm.verbal: by ebony power, let thy body wrack and spasm
induce spasm.description: this is a stackable spell, much like confusion, but the target will fall to the ground and writhe uncontrollably for the duration of the spell.  it is not a domination effect, but a listed stopping effect.
induce spasm.note: this is a stackable glyph (see stackable glyphs on page 8)
induce spasm.expertise: may now cast this spell for 5 mana per rune, and starting at 5 levels of effect.

pass unknown.verbal: may ebony power make my step unknown
pass unknown.description: the caster makes no noise (unless deliberate), nor can be smelled, granting invisibility to those two senses only- immunity to acute hearing and locational sniff.  it also prevents detection by mana sight and elemental sight, and other visual detections by creatures made by magic without minds e.g. statues, not elves. this spell is broken if the caster engages in melee combat (use of any weapon, including mp and hp ones).

mist.verbal: with ebony power let mist rise and hide me from my foes
mist.description: the spell causes a thick mist to develop around the wizard, which moves as they do, maintaining a 10' radius around them.  whilst the casting wizard can see perfectly within the mist, no others can.  unintelligent creatures will not venture into the mist and those within the mist will try and leave it as swiftly as possible.

escape.description: this spell takes the wizard to any point that they had already been to during the course of the adventure, including the start point of the adventure.  this spell will not, however, cross planes, dimensions or any other mystical distances, and in all ways is treated as the blink spell. memorised locations may be learnt for 5pts each post 8th level, [cf. teleport].

mark ally.description: this cantrip can only be cast upon a willing target and cannot be dispelled - the casting wizard must be told by the target if they refuse to accept the mark, thus making them an unwilling target.  this spell has several purposes.  firstly, certain spells can only be cast on a target who has been marked as an ally by the wizard; these spells are the beneficial other spells of the golden magic, and certain other golden spells contained in this supplement.  secondly, should a marked ally attack the wizard then they will suffer the reverse effect of any spell cast upon them by the golden wizard - this includes any spells cast prior or subsequent to the treachery. this spell may be cast on self if desired.

shield (self).verbal: may the golden drake shield my body''
shield (self).description: the caster receives an increase in their armour class of +2 magical armour class and +2 physical armour class.  this armour can stack with any other magical or physical defence, but not plate (self), plate (other) or other spells which preclude the stacking of armour.  it cannot stack with itself.

shield (other).verbal: may the golden drake shield your body''
shield (other).description: as shield (self), but this can only be cast on an ally, as described under the mark ally spell described above.
shield (other).expertise: may be cast for only 2 mana on allies.

lesser forcewall.verbal: may the gold drake erect a shining wall of force.
lesser forcewall.description: creates a shimmering wall of gold force that is impenetrable to either magical or physical objects or beings.  this wall can be dissipated by use of the casting wizard's command word, as described under forcewall below.  the wall can be up to 20' high and 20' across, and must be a straight line.

strengthen (self).verbal: feel the power through my limbs, the drake has strengthened my body to resist my foes''.
strengthen (self).description: this increases the resistance level for the purposes of magical and physical effects for the wizard to 10 levels.  if the spell is cast after a level-based spell has already affected the wizard then the increase is only to 9 levels of resistance.  note, this does not stack with already raised increases in resistance - the increase is limited to 9 and 10.

hearten (self).verbal: golden drake, strengthen my heart with your power''.
hearten (self).description: this spell temporarily grants immunity to all forms of non-spiritual domination, non-spiritual fear and non-spiritual paralysis.  if the caster is still mobile he may cast this spell after another spell has affected him - e.g. if he is not paralysed.

strengthen (other).verbal: feel the power through your limbs, the drake has strengthened your body to resist your foes''
strengthen (other).description: as strengthen (self), except that it works on those targets detailed under the mark ally spell.
strengthen (other).expertise: may be cast for only 5 mana on allies.

hearten (other).verbal: let the golden drake strengthen your heart with its power''
hearten (other).description: as the hearten (self) spell, except that it only works on those targets detailed under the mark ally spell.
hearten (other).expertise: may be cast for only 6 mana on allies.

warding.verbal: the golden drake wards your presence from me, foe''
warding.description: this spell prevents one opponent with less than 9 levels of resistance, or 60 hits, from attacking the wizard, or from approaching within 10', forcing them to back away if need be.  the spell is broken if the wizard casts another spell, moves faster than a walk, attacks or the target is cornered and cannot get out of the 10' radius.

forcewall.verbal: golden drake, i beseech thee, erect a wall of force to protect my companions''
forcewall.description: this creates a wall of force, which is purely magical, and will prevent any creature, which is not purely spiritual or completely immune to magic, from passing the wall.  it can be up to 30' long and 30' high, but must be in a straight line.  the wizard can elect to cancel it at any time, otherwise it can be released by use of a command word.  the same command word must always be used by the wizard and must be written on his character card.  the command word can be acquired by casting a talk to inanimate spell onto the force wall.  any who know the password may also lower the force wall. the ivory drake seeks to grant her followers might in magic, on the condition that they accept her own rules and conditions.  she is a lawful entity, and her code is to be adhered to by all her followers.  to break the code results in the loss of all ivory spells until the character has been atoned. this atonement either happens at the end of the adventure or at a time previous to that at the referees' discretion. - this applies to ivory draves equally. additionally any active ivory spells on the character immediately go down.

might (self).verbal: may the drake give me strength
might (self).description: the caster gains +6/2 temporary life for the duration, which cannot be cured by spiritual means.  this spell will not stack with itself or any other temporary life-gains, except those from other ivory spells

might (other).verbal: may the drake grant my ally strength to fight beside me
might (other).description: may only be cast on a marked ally. recipient gains +6/2 temporary life in all ways as might above, only while within 20' of the caster.  should the beneficiary leave this radius the benefits are lost until the radius is entered again.

traitors shield.verbal: may the ivory drake shield me from the acts of a traitor''
traitors shield.description: this spell only works if the wizard is attacked by a creature/character who previously on the adventure was marked as being an ally by the mark ally spell.  should that ally subsequently attack the wizard the wizard benefits as follows:1: armour class rises to the maximum armour class of the wizard against attacks from the traitor - this means magical, physical and dexterity armour class. 2: the wizard gains 18 tblp and 3 life per location with respect to damage from the traitor, and the traitor only.  these extra life points cannot be cured by spiritual means.

freedom of the drake.verbal: i have the strength of my drake
freedom of the drake.description: in most ways as the published ability war-cry - if used within 2 seconds of a listed stopping effect allows the caster to shrug it off and continue to act normally, and furthermore the caster becomes immune to that stopping effect for a further 5 minutes.  however, this spell may not be used against spiritual or 'mantic stopping effects, except by elves or draves.

mobility.verbal: may the ivory drake grant me great purpose in my actions''
mobility.description: the wizard cannot, for the duration of the spell, suffer from the effects of the following spells: bind, entangle, magnetise, freeze (white glyph only), trip, slip, catalepsy, sleep, slow, spells which repel the wizard, magical petrification or similar magical stopping/slowing effects.  neither are they affected by physical effects that would mimic the above, such as knockbacks or knockdowns.

ivory warrior.verbal: may the ivory drake grant me the might of her champion, let the power enter my form and strengthen my purpose to that of x men''
ivory warrior.description: each glyph that the wizard activates on himself at the time of casting strengthens them, turning them into a mighty war machine.  for each additional glyph the verbal changes to granting the power of 3, 4 or more men.  once the spell has been cast it cannot be added to until the previous spell expires.  as with all stackable spells each glyph must be dispelled, and until all glyphs have been dispelled the spell remains at full potency. each additional glyph adds +6/+2 life points, +1 maximum armour class (up to a maximum armour class of 12) and 1 point of dexterity armour class. none of the additional life points may be spiritually cured.  the life from this spell is non-stacking with other temporary life-increases except those granted by other ivory spells.
ivory warrior.note: this is a stackable glyph (see stackable glyphs on page 8), not more than 6 runes may be benefited from at any one time.
ivory warrior.expertise: may now cast this spell for 7 mana for the 1st rune, and 6 mana for each additional rune.

enhance weapon.verbal: ivory drake, twist and transform this wizard’s weapon such that my opponents will fear it's blow''
enhance weapon.description: this spell will magically augment a traditional wizard’s weapon i.e. staff, spear or dagger.  the weapon can only be used by the wizard who cast the spell, and they cannot be physically disarmed, although a vanish will remove the weapon for 5 minutes.  the weapon is modified as follows:1: the weapon does 3 more magical damage grades, (i.e.+3 magical damage) stopping at the wizards maximum damage, normally, the maximum is quad. 2: the damage done ignores physical armour - only magical and dexterity armour can be used in defence against it. 3: the weapon will shatter any normal weapon, shield or armour used in defence against it.  it does not shatter anything else. if cast by a warlock (only) this spell will enhance any weapon instead of the above weapon types, if so desired.

sanctuary.verbal: the ivory drake offers shelter to all her allies who seek rest and shelter within the boundaries of her sanctuary''
sanctuary.description: within the range of the spell all marked allies of the wizard receive the following bonuses:1: +2 dexterity armour class.  this acts as the chosen of the dragon ability in the post 8th development system supplement.  this means that the +2 dac does not stack with blesses, curses or similar watchings.  2: 25% reduction of non-purely spiritual damage after armour calculations. this is as the cold rage ability (again, this can found in the post 8th level development system), and does not stack with any other percentile reductions of damage. 3: 9th level of resistance to magical attacks - this does not stack with any other resistance level increases.
sanctuary.note: the spell cannot be moved in any way, and no bonuses are gained unless the casting wizard is within the radius.
sanctuary.expertise: a silver wizard may repeat any published informational silver glyph they have cast, within the last minute at normal cost, again for 4 mana less. minimum 1 mana.  this can be used at most 1 per 15 minutes. this reduction is not cumulative with any other mana cost reduction. the spell must be used there and then it cannot be stored, or held over in anyway. all of these spells are obviously magical informational spells.

tell power.verbal: the silver dragon desires knowledge of your power''
tell power.description: this tells the caster what mana points and colours of mana are currently active on the target, but not what the actual spells are.

tell colour.verbal: the silver dragon desires knowledge of your colour''
tell colour.description: this tells the caster the colour of either a spell that they can see the on-going effects of, or the colour of another wizard, warlock, power master or any other type of magician who uses either innate power points or innate spells.  if the target possesses more than one colour, knowledge is granted of all colours.

tell wounds.verbal: the silver dragon desires knowledge of your wounds''
tell wounds.description: this acts in all manners as the priestly discern nature of wounds ability.  however, this spell will only work on either elves or similar magical creatures or on the wizard who cast it.

tell form.description: this tells the wizard the species of the target (e.g. human, troll, 1/2-orc, undead, wood elf or statue).  note that this spell will not differentiate between different types of the same species.

tell tracks.verbal: silver dragon, what has passed here?''
tell tracks.description: this spell grants the caster the skills tracking and shadowing for the duration, except that the caster has no need to keep a track list as would a ranger, as the silver drake has prior knowledge of all forms.

inquiry.description: this allows the wizard to ask one question of all of the surrounding elements of air, earth, fire, water, light and darkness.  the elements collectively answer with a phrase of up to 3 words.  the subject of the question must be within 20' and the elements are only aware of events that have occurred in their presence.

true sight.verbal: silver dragon, remove all deceptions from my sight''
true sight.description: the caster is no longer affected by illusions and can see them for what they are.  the wizard can see magically or physically chameleoned, invisible or otherwise hidden objects - they are immune to all visual magic or physical deceptions, seeing through disguises instantly and so on. this spell is however an infomational spell - and immunity to informational spells stops it working on that individual.

know foe.verbal: the silver dragon demands knowledge of thee, foe''
know foe.description: the caster sets up a link between themselves and a target creature.  the wizard receives a bonus of 4 points of dexterity armour class with respect to damage from the target, and gains a non-cumulative weapon mastery in any physical weapon, or weapon created by mana, used by the wizard.  the target is unable to use any attack mode against the wizard bar a weapon, and may not use any special attack modes bar from the innate nature of the weapon.  for instance, a target warlock could continue to use their magic sword, but they could not cast a lightning bolt, nor could they use the shock spell that their sword could otherwise use once per day.   note, the benefits are the game effects of the casting wizard deducing all magical information about the target - no other information is to be given to the wizard. in order to cast a jade spell a person must be of goodly alignment, as such only goodly people may learn them as specialists.

reveal living.verbal: i call upon the powers of the body and the flesh to reveal to me if life may be found... reveal living
reveal living.description: reveals if a target is living for the purposes of jade/onyx magic

strength within.verbal: may the life within grow strong and verdant power endure
strength within.description: grants the recipient 12 points of casting stamina for the duration, does not stack with itself.

strengthen the body.verbal: let verdant force strengthen your body
strengthen the body.description: grants the recipient immunity to bruising using pac, dac, and/or mac.

revive the body.verbal: let the power of the verdant dragon flow into your body. where it has given way to harm let it rise again, where it has faded due to weakness let it grow strong. let jade power revive your body.
revive the body.description: returns an individual to consciousness for the duration if they are unconscious due to damage. also ensures all limbs work for the duration if they are not working due to damage.

empower form.verbal: may verdant power flow through your body and empower your form
empower form.description: grants the recipient +18/6 life temp life. does not stack with other supernatural temp life, including itself.

eternal life.verbal: let verdant power renew your form
eternal life.description: grants the target immunity to aging.

renew the body.verbal: may verdant power touch your form, let the weakness that afflicts you fade and pass.
renew the body.description: removes all on-going strength and dex drains from the recipient. this does not remove spiritual effects.
renew the body.expertise: if cast on a target that is not suffering from a strength or dex drain then the spell can instead grant them immunity to those effects for 5 minutes.

fortitude.verbal: may your blood cease to flow, your heart cease to beat, your lungs cease to draw breath, and your body be as magic as verdant magic sustains they life.
fortitude.description: grants the target immunity to flesh and blood effects (including pain)for the duration. for 15 minutes after the spell ends (even if dispelled or otherwise ended prematurely) they have ½ effect beneficial flesh and blood (including potions).
fortitude.expertise: the spell no longer has the detrimental effects after it ends.

harden the body.verbal: let verdant power touch your body, where it was weak let it become strong.
harden the body.description: grants the recipient 25% off all bar purely spirit damage.

purge the dracon corpus.verbal: feel the touch of the jade dragon as it purifies your body
purge the dracon corpus.description: removes all on going onyx spells from the target. in order to cast an onyx spell a person must be of evil alignment, as such only evil people may learn them as specialists.

nature of the child.verbal: let your reflex’s slow and wits fade as the onyx dragon twists your form
nature of the child.description: causes the target to lose x points of dac for the duration. this cannot reduce the target below 0 dac.
nature of the child.expertise: the spell costs 2 mana less to cast, to a minimum of 3 mana.
nature of the child.special: this spell costs 2 mana plus x (the amount of dac). i.e draining 6 dac would cost 8 mana, or 6 with expertise

decay the form.verbal: let your body fade away to nothing as the onyx dragon decays your form
decay the form.description: reduces the targets maximum life by 6/2 (2 hits) per casting. this will stack with itself. immunity to diminish spirit applies.
decay the form.expertise: the first decay the form on a target causes them to lose 12/4 life (4 hits).

frailty of age.verbal: the onyx dragon twists your body, let your muscles weaken and strength fade
frailty of age.description: causes the target to lose a grade of strength for the duration, to a minimum of zero.

rend the body.verbal: the onyx dragon rips through your flesh, severing muscles to rend the body
rend the body.description: causes the target to suffer 24/4 damage to which mac does not apply. immunity to involuntary shape-shifting applies.

the body crumbles.verbal: your flesh is ruined, bones brittle and feels the might of the onyx drake as your body crumbles.
the body crumbles.description: causes all published active onyx spells on the target to become 15 minute in duration.

wither.verbal: the onyx drake grips your .... let bones crumble and flesh wither
wither.description: causes the target limb too become withered and unusable for the duration. the limb is still present and as such can suffer damage.

heart attack.verbal: the onyx dragon holds your heart in his claws, shudder and die now as they close... heart attack
heart attack.description: causes the targets heart to cease to beat for a few seconds causing them to suffer 18 tblp, 18 to the chest (6 hits to a monsters) to which mac does not apply. additionally the target suffers a magical halt at the casters skill level. this is a flesh and blood effect, and immunity to flesh and blood effects applies.

weaken the body.verbal: the might of the onyx dragon grips your flesh and weakens your body
weaken the body.description: causes the target to suffer 25% more damage from any magical attack. this applies vs pure weapon blows, but not those with a physical component. immunity to involuntary shape-shifting applies.
